title: The underdog
body:
About the best habit tracking up you can get. I tried plenty of them. They all are either not good looking, to many features, no logic in layout, or the developers are greedy and want you to pay 5$ a week for some extra symbols or no limit in the amount of habits, which is absolutely ridiculous. 

Thank you so much for making such a simple, straightforward and modern app. It deserves a way higher ranking and visibility in the search results (love the emojis as symbols as well!)

title: Nicely designed
body:
The app is really well designed, modern. However, a few things are missing:
- An option to not send reminder if the goal has already been reached
- Options to set when sending the reminder (to have different reminders on weekdays and weekend)
- a search bar to filter the icons
Keep up the good work Michal !
